page.layout: One page of text, single column; a catchword "A" and signature "legit" area at the foot is part of the last line; no margin notes. Top: ornamental border, then title block.

main_text.head: AD TIT. DIGESTORVM DE DIVERSIS REGVLIS IVRIS, NOTÆ EX CVIACIO, Fabro, Gothofr. Pacio, & optimis quibusq; ICtis aliis selectæ.
main_text.p: Ad Rubricam. De diuersis regulis Iuris antiqui.

EX omnibus partibus Iuris, variæ sententiæ & Regulæ hoc titulo proponuntur, id est multarum rerum, quæ eodem se habent modo, comprehensiones breues; vel ex eo quod plerumque fit, rerum definitiones breues. Paci hic in princ. vel, vt alii, ἀξιώματα, petita, postulata. Cuiusmodi regulæ magnā vtilitate in omni scientiarum genere adferūt. Hinc Vegetius 3. cap. 26. recenset regulas quasdam generales bellorum. Idem medicis præstant Aphorismi Hippocratis. Eodem fine Anniaeus ex Pauli sententiis quasdam Gothis suis selegit.

page.notes: The drop cap "E" is a large woodcut initial, read as E with [?]. The library stamp (Biblioteca Nazionale Roma) and the Google watermark are omitted. The word after "Anniæ" is partly illegible in the scan ("Anniaeum" likely "Annianum") and is given as printed-looking form; the Greek word "ἀξιώματα" is copied as seen. The margin letter "A" at the foot is a signature.
